test_round_criteria: Round ends at the first 10 closed real trades or on 2026-12-31, whichever comes first. Judged on win rate, average R, slippage versus the signal price, and commissions as a share of gross result, with the real record set beside the paper record over the same window. Benchmark: QQQ's change from the close the session before the round starts to the round-end close, compared with the account's change over that same window. Beating that QQQ change is the pre-agreed score for the round, not a view on holding QQQ. Circuit breaker: if the cumulative real result (trade-log realized result plus unrealized result) reaches -20% of the account before the round ends, new real-plan sizing pauses and new triggers stay on paper until the round is resumed; positions already open are still tracked.
